description.intro: Made for Manchester United fans, these adidas flip flops offer soft tread and comfort that accompanies you wherever you go. Their black design maintains an easy to combine sporty aesthetic in any situation.
key_benefits: Cloudfoam midsole: Offers ultra-soft footprint with extra cushioning for added comfort.
Top strip: Facilitates a practical fit and allows easy fit.
Lightweight and versatile design: Perfect for swimming pool, beach, wardrobe or daily use.
Escudo del Manchester United: Aporta un acabado oficial para lucir los colores del club con orgullo.
